name: Freighter (white tail)
description: All white, windows plugged. A large red phoenix on the white fin; forward, the small red phoenix, 首都航空 in black and a large 'Capital Airlines' in black italic over the plugged window line; under the forward cabin the blue JDA mark with 江西国际货运 (Jiangxi International Cargo). White engines.

titles.style: The Chinese name in black brush characters behind the small phoenix.
Large black bold italic sans across the plugged window line, larger than on the passenger aircraft.

logos.description: The phoenix in red on the white fin: head and crest facing forward over sweeping feathers.
The small red phoenix ahead of the Chinese name.
Jiangxi International Cargo's blue 'JDA' mark followed by 江西国际货运 and 'JIANGXI INTERNATIONAL CARGO' small, under the forward cabin.

notes: B-32MG only so far (an A330-200 converted to a freighter): measured on its left side at Budapest (2026-04-05, taking off, nose up; the fit takes the pitch out) on the A330-200 shape with the windows hidden. The titles' baselines read slanted in this nose-up view; drawn at their mean. 'Capital Airlines' runs x 0.284-0.395 with a cap height about 0.26 of the body's height, about twice the passenger scheme's. The JDA mark says it flies for Jiangxi International Cargo; whether it uses Capital's CBJ callsign on every flight isn't sourced here (the maintainer's sighting did). A main-deck cargo door on the forward left side isn't drawn (doors belong to the shape).
